visibleTestCases.title: Atomic Transfer Between Wallets
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin ok = mnesia_ledger:setup_mnesia_table(), ok = mnesia_ledger:upsert_wallet(alice, 100), ok = mnesia_ledger:upsert_wallet(bob, 50), {ok, 60, 90} = mnesia_ledger:atomic_transfer(alice, bob, 40), mnesia_ledger:get_wallet_balance(alice) end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Tests setting up accounts, atomic debit/credit, and balance retrieval.

visibleTestCases.title: Overdraft Rollback Invariant
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {error, insufficient_funds} = mnesia_ledger:atomic_transfer(alice, bob, 500), {mnesia_ledger:get_wallet_balance(alice), mnesia_ledger:get_wallet_balance(bob)} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Verifies that aborting on insufficient funds rolls back all changes completely.
